input.brief: Which of our four growth bets should get next quarter budget?

candidates.label: served_v17
candidates.note: Verbatim decision_review object extracted from the arm's raw model text (json_text).

output.narrative_summary: This result rests on the link from Customer Acquisition Cost to New Revenue. If that cost rises enough, more runs could support a different option. In this model, 41% of runs supported Self Serve Funnel.

story_headlines.opt_selfserve: Self Serve Funnel holds up because its result stays strong even as acquisition cost assumptions shift.
story_headlines.opt_paid: Paid Acquisition would need a lower effective acquisition cost to draw more supporting runs.
story_headlines.opt_partner: Partner Channel would need stronger modelled outcomes relative to its acquisition cost to draw more runs.
story_headlines.opt_outbound: Outbound Sales would need a materially lower acquisition cost to draw more supporting runs.

robustness_explanation.summary: The ordering holds in about 64% of variations, a moderate level based on current estimates.
robustness_explanation.primary_risk: The link from Customer Acquisition Cost to New Revenue is the main source of fragility here.
stability_factors: Self Serve Funnel's modelled outcome stays ahead across a wide range of plausible values
fragility_factors: The link from Customer Acquisition Cost to New Revenue could shift which option more runs support

output.readiness_rationale: The comparison is settled enough to act on, though the link from Customer Acquisition Cost to New Revenue is worth checking before committing budget.

fac_cac.specific_action: Pull actual blended acquisition cost from the last two quarters of spend and conversion data.
fac_cac.rationale: This figure most affects how the options compare in this model.
fac_cac.decision_hygiene: Estimate the current acquisition cost before looking at the actual figure.

edge_cac_growth.trigger_description: If Customer Acquisition Cost rises well beyond current levels while New Revenue assumptions stay fixed...
edge_cac_growth.consequence: ...then the most runs would support Paid Acquisition rather than Self Serve Funnel.

flip_thresholds.narrative: If Customer Acquisition Cost moves from 420 GBP to 610 GBP, more runs would support a different option.

key_assumptions: The link from Customer Acquisition Cost to New Revenue assumes current market and channel conditions hold next quarter.
The brief frames this as a single-quarter allocation across four bets, assuming channel performance will not fundamentally shift mid-quarter.

decision_quality_prompts.question: What would make you switch to Paid Acquisition?
decision_quality_prompts.applies_because: Self Serve Funnel's own share is above the common threshold for checking the opposite case, so it is worth naming what would change the picture.

decision_quality_prompts.question: Choosing Self Serve Funnel, what does giving up Partner Channel and Outbound Sales cost?
decision_quality_prompts.applies_because: Four options are being compared for a single quarter's budget, so the cost of forgoing the others is worth stating explicitly.

pre_mortem.failure_scenario: Self Serve Funnel underperforms because Customer Acquisition Cost climbs past modelled levels, eroding the New Revenue it was expected to produce.
warning_signs: Blended acquisition cost trending up over consecutive weeks
Conversion rate from the self serve funnel slipping below plan
pre_mortem.mitigation: Set an acquisition cost ceiling and review channel spend against it before committing further budget.
pre_mortem.review_trigger: Reconvene if acquisition cost trends toward the higher end of modelled estimates before next planning cycle.
